description: This file defines a template interface IIteratorType for iterating over elements, and a template class IteratorType implementing a generic iterator pattern with support for various container types. It is part of the WPEFramework RPC namespace and includes methods for iteration control, reference counting, and container management.

classes.name: IIteratorType
classes.description: A virtual interface for iterator operations over elements of type ELEMENT, including navigation and state queries.

classes.name: IteratorType
classes.description: A template class implementing a generic iterator over a container, supporting various container types and iteration operations.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next element, returning true if successful.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous element, returning true if successful.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to a specified position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the container.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns the current element pointed to by the iterator.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an element to the container.
